en.s: The Battle of Assandun (or Essendune) was fought between Danish and English armies on 18 October 1016. There is disagreement whether Assandun may be Ashdon near Saffron Walden in north Essex or, as long supposed, Ashingdon near Rochford in southeast Essex, England. It ended in victory for the Danes, led by Canute the Great, who triumphed over the English army led by King Edmund Ironside.

zh.s: 1016年10月18日，丹麦军队与英格兰军队在阿桑登交战。战场的确切位置仍有争议：一说位于英格兰埃塞克斯郡北部、萨弗伦沃尔登附近的阿什登，另一种沿袭已久的说法则认为在该郡东南部、罗奇福德附近的阿欣登。克努特大帝率领的丹麦军队最终获胜，击败了“刚勇者”埃德蒙国王统率的英格兰军队。

en.s: The Battle of Dyrrhachium (near present-day Durrës in Albania) took place on October 18, 1081 between the Byzantine Empire, led by the Emperor Alexios I Komnenos (r. 1081–1118), and the Normans of southern Italy under Robert Guiscard, Duke of Apulia and Calabria. The battle was fought outside the city of Dyrrhachium (also known as Durazzo), the Byzantine capital of Illyria, and ended in a Norman victory. Following the Norman conquest of Byzantine Italy and Saracen Sicily, the Byzantine emperor, Michael VII Doukas (r. 1071–1078), betrothed his son to Robert Guiscard's daughter. When Michael was deposed, Robert took this as an excuse to invade the Byzantine Empire in 1081.

zh.s: 1081年10月18日，拜占庭军队与南意大利的诺曼人在迪拉基乌姆城外交战，诺曼人获胜。这座城市也叫杜拉佐，位于今天阿尔巴尼亚的杜勒斯附近，当时是拜占庭帝国伊利里亚地区的首府。拜占庭军队由皇帝阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁率领，他在1081至1118年间在位。诺曼人的统帅是阿普利亚和卡拉布里亚公爵罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔。此前，诺曼人已征服拜占庭控制的意大利领土和撒拉森人控制的西西里。拜占庭皇帝米海尔七世·杜卡斯在1071至1078年间在位，曾安排自己的儿子与罗贝尔的女儿订婚。米海尔被废黜后，罗贝尔以此为借口，于1081年入侵拜占庭帝国。

en.t: Michael the Syrian is consecrated patriarch of Antioch
en.s: On October 18, 1166, Michael the Syrian was consecrated patriarch of Antioch at the Monastery of Mor Barsawmo near Melitene, in present-day Turkey.

zh.t: 叙利亚人米海尔获祝圣为安提阿牧首
zh.s: 1166年10月18日，叙利亚人米海尔在梅利特内附近的Mor Barsawmo修道院获祝圣为安提阿牧首。当地位于今土耳其境内。

en.s: The siege of Alcácer do Sal lasted from 30 July to 18 October 1217. The well fortified city of Alcácer do Sal was a frontier outpost of the Almohad Caliphate facing Portugal. It was besieged by forces from Portugal, León, the military orders and the Fifth Crusade. The latter were led by Count William I of Holland.

zh.t: 阿尔卡塞尔杜萨尔围城战
zh.s: 阿尔卡塞尔杜萨尔围城战于1217年7月30日至10月18日进行。阿尔卡塞尔杜萨尔是一座防御坚固的城市，是面向葡萄牙的阿尔摩哈德哈里发国边境据点。围攻者包括葡萄牙、莱昂、军事修会和第五次十字军的军队，第五次十字军由荷兰伯爵威廉一世率领。

en.s: The Mongol siege, capture, and sack of Chernigov, the capital of the Chernigov Principality, occurred on October 18, 1239, during the westward expansion of the Mongol Empire. It was part of the 1237–1242 Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus'.

zh.t: 切尔尼戈夫陷落与劫掠
zh.s: 1239年10月18日，蒙古帝国在向西扩张期间围攻、攻占并劫掠切尔尼戈夫公国首都切尔尼戈夫。这是1237年至1242年蒙古入侵基辅罗斯的一部分。

en.s: The 1356 Basel earthquake is the most significant seismological event to have occurred in Central Europe in recorded history and had a moment magnitude in the range of 6.0–7.1. This earthquake, which occurred on 18 October 1356, is also known as the Sankt-Lukas-Tag Erdbeben (English: Saint Luke's Day Earthquake), as 18 October is the feast day of Saint Luke the Evangelist.

zh.s: 1356年巴塞尔地震是有记录以来中欧最重大的地震，矩震级估计为6.0至7.1级。地震发生于1356年10月18日，也称圣路加日地震，因为10月18日是传教士圣路加的节日。

en.s: The siege of Opochka was an unsuccessful attempt by the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Kingdom of Poland to conquer the Russian fortress of Opochka during the Fourth Muscovite–Lithuanian War. Russian troops were able to successfully defend the fortress and inflict heavy damage on the Poles and Lithuanians, avenging the defeat at Orsha three years ago.

zh.s: 立陶宛大公国和波兰王国曾试图攻占俄罗斯要塞奥波奇卡，但围城战以失败告终。此次行动发生在第四次莫斯科-立陶宛战争期间。俄军成功守住要塞，并给波兰和立陶宛军队造成重大损失，报了三年前奥尔沙战役战败之仇。

en.t: Cortés’s forces massacre residents of Cholula
en.s: On October 18, 1519, forces led by Hernán Cortés carried out a massacre in Cholula, in present-day Mexico.

zh.t: 科尔特斯的军队在乔卢拉实施屠杀
zh.s: 1519年10月18日，埃尔南·科尔特斯率领的军队在今墨西哥的乔卢拉实施屠杀。

en.t: De Soto’s expedition fights Indigenous defenders at Mabila
en.s: On October 18, 1540, Hernando de Soto’s expedition fought Indigenous defenders at Mabila, a fortified settlement in present-day Alabama, United States.

zh.t: 德索托的远征队在马比拉与原住民交战
zh.s: 1540年10月18日，埃尔南多·德索托的远征队在马比拉与原住民守军交战。马比拉是一处设防聚落，位于今美国阿拉巴马州境内。

en.t: In Japan the fourth Battle of Kawanakajima is fought between the forces of Uesugi Kenshin and Takeda Shingen, resulting in a draw
en.s: The Battles of Kawanakajima (川中島の戦い, Kawanakajima no tatakai) were a series of battles fought in the Sengoku period of Japan between Takeda Shingen of Kai Province and Uesugi Kenshin of Echigo Province from 1553 to 1564. Shingen and Kenshin contested each other for control of the plain of Kawanakajima between the Sai River and Chikuma River in northern Shinano Province, located in the present-day city of Nagano.

zh.t: 日本上杉谦信与武田信玄军队进行第四次川中岛之战，最终战平
zh.s: 川中岛之战（川中島の戦い，Kawanakajima no tatakai）是日本战国时代一系列战役的统称。1553年至1564年间，甲斐国的武田信玄与越后国的上杉谦信多次交战，争夺信浓国北部川中岛平原的控制权。该平原位于犀川与千曲川之间，现属长野市。

en.t: Matsura’s fleet attacks Portuguese ships at Fukuda Bay
en.s: On the morning of October 18, 1565, a fleet sent by Matsura Takanobu attacked Portuguese ships at Fukuda Bay, in present-day Nagasaki, Japan. Portuguese cannon fire drove the attackers back.

zh.t: 松浦隆信的船队在福田浦袭击葡萄牙船只
zh.s: 1565年10月18日清晨，松浦隆信派出的船队在今日本长崎的福田浦袭击葡萄牙船只，随后被葡萄牙舰炮击退。

en.s: The siege of Steenwijk took place from October 18, 1580 – February 23, 1581 during the Eighty Years' War, between a besieging Spanish force under turncoat George van Lalaing against a Dutch garrison at Steenwijk under Johan van den Kornput. A Dutch force under John Norreys successfully relieved the town on January 24, and the Spanish in addition to ill-health and lack of supplies subsequently lifted the siege in February.

zh.s: 八十年战争期间，斯滕韦克围城战从1580年10月18日持续至1581年2月23日。倒向西班牙一方的乔治·范拉兰率领西班牙军队围城，约翰·范登科恩普特指挥荷兰驻军防守。约翰·诺里斯率领的荷兰援军于1月24日成功抵达并增援该镇。此后，西班牙军队又受到疾病和补给短缺的困扰，最终于2月撤围。

en.t: Spain’s third armada sails from A Coruña
en.s: On October 18, 1597, a Spanish armada commanded by Martín de Padilla sailed from A Coruña, Spain, on an expedition against England.

zh.t: 西班牙第三支无敌舰队从拉科鲁尼亚启航
zh.s: 1597年10月18日，马丁·德·帕迪利亚率领西班牙舰队从拉科鲁尼亚启航，远征英格兰。

en.s: The Battle of Șelimbăr, or Battle of Sellenberk (Hungarian: Sellenberk; German: Schellenberg), took place on 18 October 1599 between the Wallachian army of Michael the Brave (Romanian: Mihai Viteazul) and the Transylvanian-Hungarian army of Andrew Báthory (Hungarian: Báthory András). The battle was fought near the village of Șelimbăr (Hungarian: Sellenberk) close to Sibiu (German: Hermannstadt; Hungarian: Nagyszeben).

zh.s: 舍林巴尔战役又称塞伦贝尔克战役（匈牙利语：Sellenberk；德语：Schellenberg），于1599年10月18日爆发。交战双方是勇者米哈伊率领的瓦拉几亚军队和安德拉什·巴托里率领的特兰西瓦尼亚-匈牙利军队。战斗发生在舍林巴尔村附近，距锡比乌不远；锡比乌的德语名为Hermannstadt，匈牙利语名为Nagyszeben。

en.s: The Battle of Kitombo was a military engagement between forces of the BaKongo state of Soyo, formerly a province of the Kingdom of Kongo, and the Portuguese colony of Angola on 18 October 1670. Earlier in the year a Portuguese expeditionary force had invaded Soyo with the intention of ending its independent existence.

zh.s: 1670年10月18日，索约与葡属安哥拉的军队在基通博交战。索约是巴刚果人建立的国家，原为刚果王国的一个省。同年早些时候，一支葡萄牙远征军入侵索约，企图结束其独立地位。

en.s: The Battle of Kassa was fought on October 18, 1685, in the city of Kassa in the Kingdom of Hungary (now Košice in Slovakia), between the armies of the Ottoman Empire and of the Holy Roman Empire. The Austrian Commander, Field Marshal Aeneas de Caprara, defeated the Turkish army near the city and with this victory regained Habsburg control of which had been lost in 1682 to the Kuruc leader Imre Thököly. Košice at the time was defended by a modern pentagonal fortress (citadel) built by the Habsburgs south of the city in the 1670s.

zh.s: 1685年10月18日，奥斯曼帝国与神圣罗马帝国的军队在匈牙利王国的卡萨交战。卡萨就是今天斯洛伐克的科希策。奥地利统帅、陆军元帅艾涅阿斯·德·卡普拉拉在城外击败土耳其军队，使哈布斯堡王朝重新控制了这片地区。该地区此前于1682年落入库鲁克军领袖伊姆雷·特凯利手中。当时，科希策由城南一座五边形堡垒防守。这座堡垒是哈布斯堡王朝在17世纪70年代修建的，采用了当时较先进的防御设计。

en.s: The War of the Austrian Succession, 1740 to 1748, was a conflict between the European great powers, fought primarily in Europe, the Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean Sea. Related conflicts include King George's War, the War of Jenkins' Ear, the First Carnatic War, and the First and Second Silesian Wars. Its immediate cause was the right of Maria Theresa to inherit Austria.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥地利王位继承战争发生于1740年至1748年，是欧洲列强之间的一场冲突，战事主要在欧洲、大西洋和地中海进行。相关冲突包括乔治王之战、詹金斯耳之战、第一次卡纳提克战争，以及第一次和第二次西里西亚战争。战争的直接起因是玛丽亚·特蕾莎继承奥地利的权利受到质疑。

en.s: The Burning of Falmouth (October 18, 1775) was an attack by a fleet of Royal Navy vessels on the town of Falmouth, Massachusetts (site of the modern city of Portland, Maine, and not to be confused with the modern towns of Falmouth, Massachusetts, or Falmouth, Maine). The fleet was commanded by Captain Henry Mowat.

zh.s: 法尔茅斯焚毁事件发生于1775年10月18日，是英国皇家海军舰队对马萨诸塞州法尔茅斯镇发动的一次袭击。该地现为缅因州波特兰市所在地；不要与现今马萨诸塞州或缅因州的法尔茅斯镇混淆。舰队由亨利·莫瓦特船长指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Pell's Point (October 18, 1776), also known as the Battle of Pelham, was a skirmish fought between British and American troops during the New York and New Jersey campaign of the American Revolutionary War. The conflict took place in what is now part of Pelham Bay Park in the Bronx, New York City. On October 12, British forces landed at Throgs Neck in order to execute a flanking maneuver that would trap Gen. George Washington, commander-in-chief of the American revolutionary forces, and the main body of the Continental Army on the island of Manhattan.

zh.s: 1776年10月18日，英军与美军在佩尔斯角发生小规模战斗。这场战斗也叫佩勒姆之战，属于美国独立战争中的纽约和新泽西战役。战场位于今天纽约市布朗克斯区佩勒姆湾公园的一部分。此前，英军于10月12日在特罗格斯内克登陆，打算从侧翼包抄，把美国革命军总司令乔治·华盛顿将军和大陆军主力困在曼哈顿岛上。

en.s: The siege of Savannah or the second battle of Savannah was an encounter of the American Revolutionary War (1775–1783) in 1779. The year before, the city of Savannah, Georgia, had been captured by a British expeditionary corps under Lieutenant-Colonel Archibald Campbell. The siege itself consisted of a joint Franco-American attempt to retake Savannah, from September 16 to October 18, 1779.

zh.s: 萨凡纳围城战又称第二次萨凡纳战役，是1779年美国独立战争期间的一场战斗。前一年，英国远征军在阿奇博尔德·坎贝尔中校率领下攻占了佐治亚州萨凡纳。法美联军于1779年9月16日至10月18日围攻萨凡纳，试图夺回该城。

en.s: The action of 18 October 1782 was a minor naval engagement of the American Revolutionary War, in which the French 74-gun ship of the line Scipion, accompanied by the 40-gun frigate Sibylle, was chased by two Royal Navy ships of the line, the 98-gun HMS London and the 74-gun Torbay. Outmanoeuvring her larger opponents, Scipion obtained a favourable position that allowed her to rake London, causing severe damage and allowing her to continue running from the superior British force.

zh.s: 1782年10月18日海战是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模海战。法国74炮战列舰“西庇阿”号由40炮护卫舰“西比尔”号陪同，遭到英国皇家海军两艘战列舰追击，分别是98炮“伦敦”号和74炮“托尔贝”号。“西庇阿”号以机动摆脱较大的对手，抢占有利位置，侧舷炮击“伦敦”号并造成严重损伤，随后得以继续躲避实力更强的英军。

en.s: The action at Mannheim began in April 1795 when two French armies crossed the Rhine and converged on the confluence of the Main and the Rhine. Initial action at Mannheim resulted in a minor skirmish, but the Bavarian commander negotiated a quick truce with the French and withdrew. On 17 October 1795, 17,000 Habsburg Austrian troops under the command of Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser engaged 12,000 soldiers, led by Jean-Charles Pichegru in the grounds outside the city of Mannheim.

zh.s: 曼海姆战役于1795年4月打响，两支法国军队渡过莱茵河，在美因河与莱茵河交汇处会师。曼海姆附近最初发生小规模冲突，但巴伐利亚指挥官很快与法军达成停战并撤退。1795年10月17日，达戈贝特·西格蒙德·冯·武尔姆瑟率领1.7万名哈布斯堡奥地利军队，在曼海姆城外与让-夏尔·皮舍格吕率领的1.2万名士兵交战。

en.s: The Battle of Verona was fought on 18 October 1805 between the French Army of Italy under the command of André Masséna and an Austrian army led by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen. By the end of the day, Massena seized a bridgehead on the east bank of the Adige River, driving back the defending troops under Josef Philipp Vukassovich. The action took place near the city of Verona in northern Italy during the War of the Third Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. In the fall of 1805, Emperor Napoleon I of France planned for his powerful Grande Armée to fall upon and crush the Austrian Empire army in southern Germany.

zh.s: 1805年10月18日，安德烈·马塞纳率领的法国意大利军团，在维罗纳附近与奥地利军队交战。奥军由特申公爵卡尔大公率领。当天结束前，马塞纳击退了约瑟夫·菲利普·武卡索维奇指挥的守军，在阿迪杰河东岸夺下了一处桥头阵地。维罗纳位于意大利北部，这场战斗属于拿破仑战争中的第三次反法同盟战争。1805年秋，法国皇帝拿破仑一世计划动用实力强大的大军团，进攻并击溃德意志南部的奥地利帝国军队。

en.s: The action of 18 October 1806 was a naval engagement of the Java campaign of 1806–1807 fought between the Royal Navy frigate Caroline and a Dutch navy squadron near the entrance to the city harbour of Batavia in the Dutch East Indies. During the battle, the Dutch frigate Maria Riggersbergen was left unsupported by the remainder of the squadron and, isolated, was forced to strike her colours.

zh.s: 1806年10月18日海战是1806至1807年爪哇战役中的一场海战，交战双方是英国皇家海军“卡罗琳”号护卫舰和荷兰海军一支舰队，战斗发生在荷属东印度巴达维亚港口入口附近。荷兰护卫舰“玛丽亚·里赫斯贝亨”号未获舰队其他船只支援，孤立无援后被迫降旗投降。

en.s: The invasion of Capri was the successful recapture of the Italian island of Capri from Britain by the Kingdom of Naples on 4–18 October 1808.

en.s: The Battle of Tamames was a sharp reversal suffered by part of Marshal Michel Ney's French army under Major-General Jean Marchand in the Peninsular War. The French, advancing out of Salamanca, were met and defeated in battle by a Spanish army on October 18, 1809.

zh.s: 1809年10月18日，半岛战争中的一支法军在塔马梅斯遭遇重挫。这支部队隶属米歇尔·内伊元帅麾下，由让·马尔尚少将指挥。他们从萨拉曼卡出发推进，途中与西班牙军队交战并被击败。

en.s: The Battle of Tarutino (18 October 1812; Russian: Тарутинское сражение) was a part of Napoleon's invasion of Russia. In the battle, Russian troops under the general command of Bennigsen, acting on instructions from Kutuzov and being part of his army, launched a surprise attack and defeated French troops under Murat's command.

en.s: The capture of HMS Frolic was a naval action fought in the Atlantic on 18 October 1812, between the sloop-of-war USS Wasp, commanded by Master Commandant Jacob Jones, and the Cruizer-class brig-sloop HM Brig Frolic, under Commander Thomas Whinyates. The Americans captured the British vessel, but both vessels shortly thereafter were captured by a British ship of the line which happened upon the scene of the battle.

en.s: The siege of Torgau (18 October 1813 – 10 January 1814) was a siege in the War of the Sixth Coalition. The French-held fortress on the Elbe was besieged by Prussian troops and forced to surrender.

en.s: The Battle of Gimry, fought on 17–18 October 1832 during the Murid War, was General Aleksey Velyaminov's capture of Ghazi Muhammad's headquarters at Gimry. Ghazi Muhammad was killed, but Imam Shamil managed to escape. In early October, Velyaminov left Temir-Khan-Shura (Buynaksk) 25 km to the east. The route led through early snow across a broad and level plateau which slowly rises from 1,500 feet to 6,000 feet and then suddenly drops 5,000 feet down into the canyon of the north-flowing Avar Koysu.

zh.s: 吉姆雷战役于1832年10月17日至18日在穆里德战争期间进行。阿列克谢·维利亚米诺夫将军攻占了加齐·穆罕默德在吉姆雷的总部。加齐·穆罕默德阵亡，但伊玛目沙米尔成功逃脱。10月初，维利亚米诺夫从东面25公里处的捷米尔-汗-舒拉（布伊纳克斯克）出发。部队沿途遇到初雪，穿越一片广阔平坦的高原；高原从海拔1,500英尺缓慢升至6,000英尺，随后骤降5,000英尺，进入向北流淌的阿瓦尔科伊苏河峡谷。

en.s: The 1865 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on October 18, 1865 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. en.s: The 1866 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on October 18, 1866. The incumbent governor Jonathan Worth defeated Alfred Dockery. Worth had defeated the provisional governor and wartime unionist William Woods Holden at the previous election. During his term, he assembled a coalition of Conservative Unionists and former Confederates aligned with the Reconstruction policies of president Andrew Johnson that swept Holden's allies from power.

zh.t: 1866年美国北卡罗来纳州州长选举
zh.s: 1866年10月18日，北卡罗来纳州举行州长选举，现任州长乔纳森·沃思击败阿尔弗雷德·多克里。在上届选举中，沃思曾击败临时州长威廉·伍兹·霍尔登；霍尔登在内战期间支持联邦。沃思任内把保守派联邦支持者与前邦联人士联合起来，支持安德鲁·约翰逊总统的重建政策，使霍尔登的盟友失去权力。

en.s: The Battle of Châteaudun took place in northwestern France during the Franco-Prussian War on 18 October 1870. In this battle, the Imperial German Army led by General Friedrich Wilhelm Ludwig von Wittich attacked the city of Châteaudun and captured the city. During the nine-hour battle the attackers defeated forces that included Francs-tireurs led by Ernest de Lipowski who was of Polish origin.

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 4 and 18 October 1885. Following the deaths of Louis-Napoléon, Prince Imperial and the Comte de Chambord, the monarchists and Bonapartists formed a conservative electoral alliance under the leadership of Baron Armand de Mackau. In the first round of the election, the conservatives won 176 seats, whereas the Opportunist Republicans – partly because radical and moderate Republicans ran against each other, underestimating the danger from the right - only won 127.

zh.s: 1885年10月4日和18日，法国举行议会选举。拿破仑皇太子路易-拿破仑与尚博尔伯爵去世后，保皇派和波拿巴派在阿尔芒·德·马科男爵领导下组成保守派选举联盟。首轮投票中，保守派获得176席，机会主义共和派仅得127席。共和派失利的原因之一，是激进派和温和派低估了右翼带来的威胁，彼此分开参选、争夺选票。

en.s: The Battle of Senluo Temple was a clash between 1,000-1,500 men of the "Militia United in Righteousness" (simplified Chinese: 义和团; traditional Chinese: 義和團; pinyin: Yìhètuán; better known as the "Boxers") and Qing government troops that took place on October 18, 1899, near a temple located on the western edge of Pingyuan County in northwestern Shandong. The Boxers were armed with swords, spears and a few hunting rifles. In a first skirmish they inflicted a few casualties on Qing troops and forced them to retreat, but the Qing army won the battle in a counterattack during which at least 27 Boxers were killed.

zh.s: 1899年10月18日，约1000至1500名义和团成员在山东西北部平原县西郊的一座寺庙附近，与清政府军队交战。义和团成员拿着刀、长矛和少量猎枪，最初给清军造成了一些伤亡，并迫使清军撤退。随后清军反击并获胜，反击中至少有27名义和团成员丧生。

en.s: The German campaign in Angola took place before the official declaration of war between Germany and Portugal in March 1916. German and Portuguese troops clashed several times on the border between German South West Africa and Portuguese Angola. The Germans won most of these clashes and were able to occupy the Humbe region of southern Angola until Portuguese control was restored a few days before the South African-led South West Africa campaign liquidated German rule in the region.

en.s: The Newport by-election, 1922 was by-election held in the parliamentary constituency of Newport on 18 October 1922. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on Sunday, 18 October 1981. The Panhellenic Socialist Movement (PASOK), led by Andreas Papandreou, faced New Democracy, led by Georgios Rallis. Papandreou achieved a landslide and PASOK formed the first socialist government in the history of Greece (in 1963 Centrists had formed a government under the leadership of George Papandreou, Andreas' father, but their party, Center Union, was not a socialist party but a centrist, social-liberal one). 185 of the 300 seats were won by PASOK or the Communist Party: both openly eurosceptic. This was the high point of Greek euroscepticism, coming just months after the country's accession to the European Communities.

zh.s: 希腊于1981年10月18日星期日举行议会选举。安德烈亚斯·帕潘德里欧领导的泛希腊社会主义运动，与乔治奥斯·拉利斯领导的新民主党展开角逐。帕潘德里欧以压倒性优势获胜，泛希腊社会主义运动由此组建了希腊历史上第一个社会主义政府。1963年，安德烈亚斯的父亲乔治·帕潘德里欧也曾领导中间派组阁，但他的中间联盟属于奉行社会自由主义的中间派政党，并非社会主义政党。在议会300个席位中，185席由泛希腊社会主义运动或共产党获得，两党都公开质疑欧洲一体化。此时距离希腊加入欧洲共同体只有几个月，这场选举也标志着希腊疑欧情绪达到高点。

en.s: The Eastbourne by-election, 1990 was a by-election held on 18 October 1990 for the British House of Commons constituency of Eastbourne in East Sussex. en.s: The Croat–Bosniak War was a conflict between the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the self-proclaimed Croatian Republic of Herzeg-Bosnia, supported by Croatia, that lasted from 18 October 1992 to 23 February 1994. It is often referred to as a "war within a war" because it was part of the larger Bosnian War. In the beginning, Bosniaks (Bosnian Muslims) and Croats fought in an alliance against the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) and the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS), but by the end of 1992 tensions between them increased. The first armed incidents occurred in October 1992 in central Bosnia between local Croat and Bosniak forces.

zh.t: 克罗地亚族与波什尼亚克族之间的战争

en.s: Merpati Nusantara Airlines Flight 5601 (MNA5601/MZ5601) was a domestic scheduled passenger flight from Semarang to Bandung, Indonesia. On 18 October 1992, the two-year-old CASA/IPTN CN-235-10 was on approach to Bandung when it crashed into Mount Puntang, near Mount Papandayan, West Java, Indonesia at 1:30 pm in bad weather. en.s: The Bolivian Gas War (Spanish: Guerra del Gas) or Bolivian gas conflict was a social confrontation in Bolivia reaching its peak in 2003, centering on the exploitation of the country's vast natural gas reserves. The expression can be extended to refer to the general conflict in Bolivia over the exploitation of gas resources, thus including the 2005 protests and the election of Evo Morales as president. Before these protests, Bolivia had seen a series of similar earlier protests during the Cochabamba protests of 2000, which were against the privatization of the municipal water supply. The conflict had its roots in grievances over the government's economic policies concerning natural gas, as well as coca eradication policies, corruption and violent military responses against strikes. The "Bolivian gas war" thus came to a head in October 2003, leading to the resignation of President Gonzalo Sánchez de Lozada (aka "Goni"). Strikes and road blocks mounted by indigenous and labour groups (including the COB trade union) brought the country to a standstill. Violent suppression by the Bolivian armed forces left some 60 people dead in October 2003, mostly inhabitants of El Alto, located on the Altiplano above the seat of government La Paz. The governing coalition disintegrated forcing Goni to resign and leave the country on October 18, 2003.

zh.s: 玻利维亚“天然气战争”是一场围绕该国丰富天然气资源开发问题展开的社会冲突，2003年达到高潮。这个名称有时也泛指玻利维亚围绕天然气开发的长期争议，包括2005年的抗议以及埃沃·莫拉莱斯当选总统。在此之前，玻利维亚曾于2000年发生科恰班巴抗议，反对市政供水私有化。天然气冲突的根源既包括民众对政府天然气经济政策的不满，也涉及铲除古柯种植的政策、腐败，以及军方以暴力镇压罢工。2003年10月，冲突全面激化，最终导致总统贡萨洛·桑切斯·德洛萨达（昵称“戈尼”）辞职。原住民和劳工团体，包括玻利维亚工人中央工会，通过罢工和封路使全国陷入停顿。军方当月的暴力镇压造成约60人死亡，多数是埃尔阿尔托居民；该市位于高原，地势高于政府所在地拉巴斯。执政联盟随之瓦解，桑切斯·德洛萨达被迫于2003年10月18日辞职并离开玻利维亚。

en.s: Héroes Inmortales VII (Spanish for "Immortal Heroes VII") was a professional wrestling event produced by the Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) promotion. The event, which commemorated the seventh anniversary of the death of AAA founder Antonio Peña, took place on October 18, 2013, at Gimnasio Miguel Hidalgo in Puebla, Puebla. While the 2011 and 2012 Peña memorial shows were both simply billed as Héroes Inmortales, the 2013 edition returned to using a Roman numeral, VII for seven, in its name. The event was headlined by El Texano Jr. defending the AAA Mega Championship against Psycho Clown and also featured the annual Copa Antonio Peña.

zh.t: 第七届“不朽英雄”摔角赛
zh.s: “不朽英雄VII”是墨西哥AAA职业摔角联盟举办的赛事，名称中的西班牙语意为“不朽英雄”。比赛于2013年10月18日在普埃布拉州普埃布拉市的米格尔·伊达尔戈体育馆举行，纪念AAA创办人安东尼奥·佩尼亚逝世七周年。2011年和2012年的纪念赛都只使用“不朽英雄”这一名称；2013年重新加上了罗马数字VII，表示第七届。压轴赛由小特哈诺迎战Psycho Clown，卫冕AAA超级冠军头衔。赛事还设有每年举行的安东尼奥·佩尼亚杯。

en.s: The 2014 AFC Cup final was the final of the 2014 AFC Cup, the 11th edition of the AFC Cup, a football competition organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) for clubs from "developing countries" in Asia. The final was contested as a single match between Iraqi team Erbil and Kuwaiti team Al-Qadsia. The match was hosted by Erbil at the Maktoum Bin Rashid Al Maktoum Stadium in Dubai on 18 October 2014, as teams from Iraq were not allowed to host their home matches in their country due to security concerns.

zh.s: 2014年亚足联杯决赛是第11届亚足联杯的决赛。这项赛事由亚洲足球联合会为亚洲“发展中国家”的俱乐部举办。决赛为单场比赛，由伊拉克球队埃尔比勒对阵科威特球队卡迪西亚。由于安全问题，伊拉克球队不得在本国举办主场比赛，埃尔比勒因此于2014年10月18日在迪拜的马克图姆·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆体育场承办决赛。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Alberta, Canada on October 18, 2021. Chief elected officials (mayors or reeves) and councillors (or aldermen), were up for election in all cities (except Lloydminster), towns, villages, specialized municipalities, and municipal districts, as are trustees for public and separate school divisions. en.s: The 2021 Calgary municipal election was held on October 18, 2021, to elect a mayor and fourteen councillors to the Calgary City Council. In conjunction with the elections for Calgary City Council, residents cast ballots for trustees of the Calgary Board of Education and the Calgary Catholic School District, a municipal vote on the question of returning to fluoridation of the city's water supply, and three provincially mandated votes: a Senate nominee election, as well as referendums on provincial equalization and on the adoption of permanent daylight saving time.

zh.s: 2021年10月18日，卡尔加里举行市政选举，选出市长及14名市议员。居民还同时投票选举卡尔加里教育局和天主教学区的校董，并就市政供水是否恢复加氟进行投票。此外，按省级要求，当天还举行了三项投票：参议员提名人选举，以及关于省级财政均等化和是否全年实行夏令时的两项公投。

en.s: The 2021 Lethbridge municipal election was held Monday, October 18, 2021, to elect a mayor and eight councillors (at-large), the seven Lethbridge School Division trustees, and five of the Holy Spirit Catholic School Division's nine trustees (as Ward 2). Incumbent mayor Chris Spearman, announced in January 2021 that he would not seek re-election. He served 2 terms as mayor—being first elected in 2013—after having sat for several years on the Holy Spirit school board.

zh.s: 莱斯布里奇于2021年10月18日星期一举行市选举，选出市长、8名不分区市议员、莱斯布里奇学区的7名理事，以及圣灵天主教学校区9名理事中的5名（第二选区）。时任市长克里斯·斯皮尔曼于2021年1月宣布不再寻求连任。他于2013年首次当选，此前曾在圣灵学校董事会任职多年；他担任市长共两个任期。

In conjunction with the municipal elections, residents voted in a provincially mandated Senate nominee election, a referendum on equalization and on whether to adopt permanent daylight saving time.
